note: One template per asset class. The same template and version are used for pre-use and post-use so the two inspections are comparable item for item. Every item has a photo slot; a finding cannot resolve without a photo.

items.label: Service brakes hold the trailer on a roll-out test
items.guidance: Tractor stationary, trailer charged, release parking brake and confirm the unit holds.

items.label: Air brake system leak-down within limit
items.guidance: Build pressure, shut down, listen and watch the gauge for a steady loss.

items.label: Rear marker lamps, brake lights and turn signals
items.guidance: Walk the rear of the trailer with hazard and brake inputs applied.

items.label: Tire tread depth, sidewalls and wheel hardware
items.guidance: Grade every tire position; photograph any sidewall damage or exposed cord.

items.label: Deck boards, cross-members and fasteners
items.guidance: Walk the deck, check board edges, cross-member webs and fastener heads.

items.label: Kingpin, fifth-wheel plate and coupling
items.guidance: Inspect the kingpin for wear and the plate for cracks; confirm the lock engages.

items.label: Mud flaps and splash guards
items.guidance: Confirm both flaps are present, attached and not torn.

items.label: Load securement points (D-rings, chains, straps)
items.guidance: Check every D-ring and chain for cracks, elongation and missing hardware.

items.label: Service brakes and parking brake
items.guidance: Low-speed brake test in the yard and parking brake hold on a grade.

items.label: Tires, tread and wheel hardware
items.guidance: Grade all four positions plus the spare; check lug nuts and sidewalls.

items.label: Headlights, tail lights and beacons
items.guidance: Cycle all light functions and confirm the beacon operates.

items.label: Engine, coolant and hydraulic fluid leaks
items.guidance: Check under the unit after the engine has run; look for fresh wet spots.

items.label: Belts, hoses and clamps
items.guidance: Grade belt condition and hose surfaces; squeeze hoses for softness.

items.label: Cab, body panels and doors
items.guidance: Walk the cab and service body; photograph any new dent, scrape or cracked panel.

items.label: Horn, wipers and washer fluid
items.guidance: Operate the horn, both wiper speeds and the washer spray.

items.label: Seat belts, mirrors and backup alarm
items.guidance: Confirm belt latch and retract, mirror adjustment, and alarm in reverse.

items.label: Hydraulic hoses, fittings and cylinders
items.guidance: Inspect every hose run and fitting; look for chafing, weeping and damaged wiper seals.

items.label: Tracks or tires, undercarriage wear
items.guidance: Grade track tension, grouser height, rollers and idlers, or tire condition.

items.label: Pins, bushings and pivot play
items.guidance: Work the boom and bucket; grade visible play and grease presence.

items.label: Guards, shields and interlocks in place
items.guidance: Confirm every guard is fitted and every interlock prevents operation when open.

items.label: Work lights and warning beacon
items.guidance: Cycle every work light and the beacon.

items.label: Load chart, decals and control labels legible
items.guidance: Confirm the load chart and control labels are present and readable.

items.label: Emergency stop and lockout function
items.guidance: Press the emergency stop with the machine running and confirm it shuts down.

items.label: Fluid levels and visible leaks
items.guidance: Check engine oil, coolant and hydraulic level; inspect under the machine.
